profile_text.body:
Pegasystems Inc is a public company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker PEGA. Its site describes it as a leading AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation, and says organizations use it to automate workflows, personalize customer experiences, and modernize legacy systems. The company says it has served large organizations since 1983.

On AI, the company describes its offering as grounded in best practices with governance built in. It says its AI agents operate with context, compliance, and human oversight, and that Pega Platform unifies AI for mission-critical work. It also names Pega Blueprint, which it describes as an AI-powered workspace that brings business and IT together, combining best practices and governance so design-time work moves into production.

The record shows no lawsuits and no MCP servers associated with the company. Its law exposure is listed in Massachusetts, with a count of 191.
